# APIs and Data by Subscription Plan

## Available APIs by Plan

| Data                     | Access Method                                                     | Free                    | Light           | Standard        | Premium         | Data Period       |
| ------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------- | --------------- | --------------- | --------------- | ----------------- |
| Product Master           | [API](/spec/product-master) / [CSV](/downloads/products)\*        | 1 year [4 weeks delay]  | 3 years         | 5 years         | 10 years        | Since 2015/1/1    |
| Daily Prices             | [API](/spec/prices-daily) / [CSV](/downloads/prices)\*            | 1 year [4 weeks delay]  | 3 years         | 5 years         | 10 years        | Since 2015/1/1    |
| Company Info             | [API](/spec/company-info) / [CSV](/downloads/companies)\*         | 1 year [4 weeks delay]  | 3 years         | 5 years         | 10 years        | Since 2016/3/1    |
| Events Calendar          | [API](/spec/events-cal)                                           | Available               | Available       | Available       | Available       | Recent only       |
| Market Calendar          | [API](/spec/market-cal)                                           | 4 weeks ago to 1 year   | 3 years ago     | 5 years ago     | 10 years ago    | Since 2015/1/1    |
| Trading Stats            | [API](/spec/trading-stats) / [CSV](/downloads/stats)              | -                       | 3 years         | 5 years         | 10 years        | Since 2015/6/1    |
| Index Prices             | [API](/spec/index-prices) / [CSV](/downloads/indices)             | -                       | 3 years         | 5 years         | 10 years        | Since 2015/1/1    |
| Market Analysis          | [API](/spec/market-analysis)                                      | -                       | -               | 5 years         | 10 years        | Since 2016/1/1    |

> **Note**
>
> \* CSV downloads are available for paid plans only.

## Additional Data Options

| Add-on              | Data                | Access Method                                | Storage Period |
| ------------------- | ------------------- | -------------------------------------------- | -------------- |
| Minute Price Data   | Minute Prices       | [API](/spec/prices-minute) / [CSV](/downloads/minute) | 1 year         |
| Tick Data           | Tick Prices         | [CSV](/downloads/ticks)                      | 1 year         |
